title: SimCLR
paper_title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
core_mech: 无动量教师或队列，以大 batch 内的两视图实例对和非线性投影头训练 NT-Xent。
core_mech_en: Trains an encoder and non-linear MLP projection head via in-batch NT-Xent contrastive loss across dual augmented views without momentum queues.
input_desc: 同一图像经两次随机增强得到的视图
input_en: Pair of randomly augmented views (x̃_i, x̃_j) of the same image
output_desc: 可迁移的图像 encoder 表征
output_en: Transferable visual representation h = f(x) (discarding projection head g after pretraining)

source.title: SimCLR
notes: The upstream repository is archived. Pin and isolate its legacy dependencies before attempting the original workflow.

adapter.name: SimCLR
adapter.mechanism: Two independent views, nonlinear projection and symmetric NT-Xent; self-similarities excluded.
limitations: Small patch Transformer replaces the original ResNet; grayscale synthetic augmentations; no ImageNet-scale batch/training.

verification.title: SimCLR
verification.budget_enforcement: cooperative boundary checks; not an OS allocation limit
limitations: Small patch Transformer replaces the original ResNet; grayscale synthetic augmentations; no ImageNet-scale batch/training.
